stem.en: Sort each description into the form of energy it names.

text.en: Energy due to where objects are and how they are moving
Energy that makes a thing warm
Energy that allows you to see
Energy carried by vibrations through air, water or steel
Energy to do with the position or motion of charges
Energy held inside the nuclei of atoms
Energy stored in fuels and food, in the bonds between atoms

explanation.en: Each name is fixed by what the energy is doing, not by where the object is. Mechanical energy is the only one on the list that is about an object's motion or position; the other six are about light, heat, vibration, charge, nuclei and chemical bonds. Two of them are easy to confuse: sound is energy carried by vibrations through a material, while heat is energy that has made something warmer - a kettle is full of thermal energy, and a ringing bell is giving sound energy away.

hints.en: For each description, ask what the energy is doing: is it making something warmer, letting you see, travelling through a material as vibration, or sitting in a bond?
Only one of the seven is about an object's motion or position. That is the one we can put a number on so far, and it is the only one you meet in a mechanics calculation.
